conflicts.permit: The third parties may have access to information such as your device identifier, MAC address, IMEI, locale (specific information where a given language is spoken), geo-location information, and IP address for the purpose of providing their services under their respective privacy policies.
conflicts.prohibit: We will not share this information with any third party without your permission.
conflicts.situation: A mobile player's IP-based location is made available to Google Analytics or Adjust through SDKs in the game without the player's separate permission.
conflicts.reason: The location promise has no exception for analytics tools, and the tracking section gives third parties geo-location for their own services under their own policies without mentioning permission.

conflicts.permit: The advertisers may collect and use information about you, such as your Service session activity, device identifier, MAC address, IMEI, geo-location information and IP address.
conflicts.prohibit: We will not share this information with any third party without your permission.
conflicts.situation: Ads shown in a Genera game let ad networks collect the player's geo-location and IP address while the player has given no specific permission.
conflicts.reason: The ad network section lets advertisers collect geo-location inside the service with no consent condition, and the location promise states no exception for advertising partners.

conflicts.permit: In order to verify the installs, a device identifier may be shared with the advertiser.
conflicts.prohibit: Genera Games does not share your personal information except as approved by you or as described below
conflicts.situation: A user installs a Genera game after clicking an ad, and Genera shares the device identifier with the advertiser to verify the install.
conflicts.reason: The disclosure section lists consent, service providers, legal, merger, and aggregate sharing as the only exceptions, and install verification with advertisers is not among them. Whether a device identifier is personal information is unstated.

conflicts.permit: Genera Games may offer you the opportunity to invite your contacts from a SN Service (such as your Facebook friends) so that those contacts can be located in Genera Games’ games and/or you can invite them to join you in our games.
conflicts.prohibit: Such contact information will be used only for the purpose of sending communications to the addressee.
conflicts.situation: A player imports Facebook friends, and Genera uses the friends' contact information to find which of them already play its games.
conflicts.reason: Locating contacts in games is a use beyond sending communications, yet the next sentence limits contact information to that single purpose without saying which statement governs.

conflicts.permit: To establish and utilize, in conjunction with the information technology infrastructure, including data mining and other advanced analytical tools, in order to access, receive, and analyze data and information in furtherance of Certain’s business and market intelligence capabilities.
conflicts.prohibit: The use of information collected through the Certain Services shall be limited to the purpose of providing the service for which the Customer has engaged Certain.
conflicts.situation: Certain applies data mining to attendee registration data collected through a Customer's event service to build its own market intelligence.
conflicts.reason: One statement lists Certain's own business and market intelligence as a use of Customer Contact data, while the service provider section limits that data to providing the contracted service. Neither statement refers to the other.

conflicts.permit: If you opt to share your name, email address and postal/zip code when you purchase a subscription via iTunes then this information can be shared by Apple with the publisher of the relevant title.
conflicts.prohibit: We do not collect any personally identifiable information about the users of our apps.
conflicts.situation: A user buys an in-app subscription to an Aimer-published app via iTunes and opts to share name, email, and zip code with the publisher.
conflicts.reason: Aimer publishes apps on its own store account, so it can be the publisher receiving this data, but the app data section states without exception that no personally identifiable information about app users is collected.

conflicts.permit: We may also provide limited information to advertising platforms to help us reach people that we think will like our products and to measure the performance of our ads shown on those platforms.
conflicts.prohibit: We do not sell the personal data of our users or share personal data for targeted advertising purposes.
conflicts.situation: A California user installs the Discord app, and Discord gives that install event to an advertising platform to target and measure Discord's ads.
conflicts.reason: Providing user information to ad platforms to reach likely users resembles sharing for targeted advertising, and the policy does not explain why this disclosure falls outside the stated prohibition.
